name: google-play-console
description: Use Google Play Console reviews, store listings, releases and Android vitals from Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Manage reviews, listings, releases and Android vitals
interface.longDescription: Inspect and manage Google Play Console data from Codex or ChatGPT. The local MCP supports service accounts or local Google OAuth; the optional remote mode provides a persistent per-user OAuth connection suitable for ChatGPT apps. APK/AAB uploads remain delegated to CI.
defaultPrompt: Summarize recent reviews and suggest replies
Show release status and Android vitals for my app
Audit and improve my localized Play Store listings
